content: 1 A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House. [A Psalm] of David. I will extol{H7311} thee, O Jehovah;{H3068} For thou hast raised me up,{H1802} And hast not made my foes{H341} to rejoice{H8055} over me. 2 O Jehovah{H3068} my God,{H430} I cried{H7768} unto thee, and thou hast healed{H7495} me. 3 O Jehovah,{H3068} thou hast brought up{H5927} my soul{H5315} from Sheol;{H7585} Thou hast kept me alive,{H2421} that I should not go down{H3381} to the pit.{H953} 4 Sing{H2167} praise unto Jehovah,{H3068} O ye saints{H2623} of his, And give thanks{H3034} to his holy{H6944} memorial{H2143} [name]. 5 For his anger{H639} is but for a moment;{H7281} His favor{H7522} is for a life-time:{H2416} Weeping{H1065} may tarry{H3885} for the night,{H6153} But joy{H7440} [cometh] in the morning.{H1242} 6 As for me, I said{H559} in my prosperity,{H7959} I shall never{H5769} be moved.{H4131} 7 Thou, Jehovah,{H3068} of thy favor{H7522} hadst made my mountain{H2042} to stand{H5975} strong.{H5797} Thou didst hide{H5641} thy face;{H6440} I was troubled.{H926} 8 I cried{H7121} to thee, O Jehovah;{H3068} And unto Jehovah{H3068} I made supplication:{H2603} 9 What profit{H1215} is there in my blood,{H1818} when I go down{H3381} to the pit?{H7845} Shall the dust{H6083} praise{H3034} thee? shall it declare{H5046} thy truth?{H571} 10 Hear,{H8085} O Jehovah,{H3068} and have mercy{H2603} upon me: Jehovah,{H3068} be thou my helper.{H5826} 11 Thou hast turned{H2015} for me my mourning{H4553} into dancing;{H4234} Thou hast loosed{H6605} my sackcloth,{H8242} and girded{H247} me with gladness;{H8057} 12 To the end that [my] glory{H3519} may sing{H2167} praise to thee, and not be silent.{H1826} O Jehovah{H3068} my God,{H430} I will give thanks{H3034} unto thee for ever.{H5769}
